findings.area: cohort candidate, review, and acceptance lifecycle
evidence: test-strategy-phase0.md requires the isolated adversarial review before a candidate, requires the candidate to bind review and receipt hashes, and allows acceptance only after that review event.
No full-cohort review artifact existed before this review.

candidate-cohort-manifest-v1.json binds only cohort-reconciliation-v1.json; product-owner-acceptance-cohort-v1.json binds only the candidate and reconciliation; accepted-cohort-manifest-v1.json binds only candidate, approval, and reconciliation.
Git order alone shows candidate before approval and approval before acceptance, but cannot replace the absent cohort-review event or its exact hash binding.
findings.impact: The currently published cohort candidate, product-owner acceptance, and accepted cohort manifest fail closed. Their consumable/accepted status cannot be relied on as a valid T6 cohort lifecycle outcome.
findings.remediation: Additively revoke or supersede the current cohort candidate/approval/accepted-manifest lineage. After every blocking finding is resolved, run a separately owned full-cohort review and retain its receipt; then author a successor non-consumable candidate binding exact hashes for the reconciliation, both accepted batch manifests, active truth tests/results, full-cohort review, review receipt, and relevant role receipts. Obtain a new product-owner event bound to that exact successor candidate and review, then publish a separate successor accepted manifest. Do not mutate or relabel the current accepted manifest as if it had passed this sequence.

findings.area: required fresh-context reviewer isolation and role separation
evidence: The frozen strategy requires fresh-context-only, inherited_narrative=false, parent_ancestry_ids=[], and fork_turns=none for every role; for reviewer isolation it additionally requires a provider attestation or retained raw export beginning with the review prompt.
role-receipts/adversarial-reviewer-batch-a-v3.json truthfully sets provider-side prompt/context/spawn/session/ancestry/fork/raw-isolation fields to null and says no provider attestation is claimed.

batch-b-independent-review-v3.json states provider attestation is unavailable, and batch-b-v3-role-session-ratification.json is expressly only a local auditable-role control rather than provider-attested session proof; that ratification does not include a separate adversarial-reviewer receipt.
The current-owner historical amendment expressly preserves independent-review requirements, so its provenance/pin exception does not waive this gate.
findings.impact: The evidence packages may have green local source gates, but the required independent-review separation is unproven for both batches. A disclosure of missing proof is not the provider-attestation or raw-export evidence required by the frozen contract.
findings.remediation: Before any successor candidate, obtain retained raw review exports beginning with each review prompt or provider attestations sufficient to verify the required fresh-context and ancestry/fork fields. Retain a separately owned Batch B adversarial-reviewer receipt binding its review and source inputs. If those records cannot be obtained, leave the cohort blocked and request an explicit product-owner change to the governing protocol; do not fabricate encrypted prompt/provider values or treat local receipt separation as equivalent evidence.

disclosures: This review does not claim product-owner authority, approve a candidate, approve acceptance, or publish a successor accepted manifest.
Provider-side prompt, session, ancestry, fork, and raw-isolation fields were unavailable in this harness and are reported as unavailable rather than inferred.
Green source-truth gates establish only their stated evidence envelopes and bounded browser unknowns; they do not cure lifecycle or role-isolation failures.
